name: Investigation Request Action 1
definition: Specifies the type of action requested and reason for action.

Action.name: Action
Action.definition: Specifies the type of action requested.

ActionReason.name: Action Reason
ActionReason.definition: Provides detailed information on the action reason.

ObjectionActionReasonRule.definition: If Action/Code is equal to RQOB for Request Objection, ActionReason must be present.

ObjectionActionRule.definition: External code RQOB for Request Objection can only be populated in Action/Code when Requestor has already received a response from the Responder.
